data.one_liner: A Map implementation with history and rollback support for entries, keys and values.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Map data structure that tracks changes and supports rolling back to previous versions using a version number. It allows efficient historical management of entries, keys, and values.
use_when: You need undo/redo or version rollback capabilities for map-based data structures.
You want to track historical changes of keys and values without manual diffing.
avoid_when: You only need a standard Dart Map without history tracking overhead.
You need complex state management for UI components rather than just collection history.
strengths: Optimized consolidation with performance improvements for changed keys.
Compatible with all standard Dart platforms.
weaknesses: Adds memory and performance overhead compared to a standard Map due to history tracking.
